notes: REQ-2.1 builds on the REQ-1.1 home page at /. GET / serves frontend/dist/index.html statically. The notes area renders two sections: an h2 heading "Pinned" above the pinned notes ("Sprint goals") and an h2 heading "Others" above the unpinned notes ("Groceries", "Weekend plan"). Data comes from GET /api/notes (non-deleted records; the client splits pinned vs unpinned in render()). Acceptance test asserts "Sprint goals" and "Groceries" are visible on the home page plus /pinned/i and /others|notes/i text; all four are present: titles in note cards rendered from the server seed, headings in the served HTML. No new routes, no schema changes; existing REQ-1.1 features (composer, search, sidebar, settings) untouched.
